summary.en: Infortec Consultores is seeking an experienced Python Developer (5+ years) for a fully remote international project, building web applications with Flask and Plotly Dash, processing data with Pandas and NumPy, and working with SQL databases and CI/CD pipelines via GitHub Actions. Cloud skills in AWS, Terraform, and Snowflake are a bonus; English B2 is required.
summary.lv: Infortec Consultores meklē pieredzējušu Python izstrādātāju (5+ gadu pieredze) pilnīgi attālinātam starptautiskam projektam, veidojot Flask un Plotly Dash lietotnes un apstrādājot datus ar Pandas un NumPy. Papildu punkti par AWS, Terraform un Snowflake; nepieciešams angļu valodas B2 līmenis.
